اخضوضعا (form XII)
# اِخْضَوْضَعَا (iḵḍawḍaʕā) /ix.dˤaw.dˤa.ʕaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِخْضَوْضَعَ (iḵḍawḍaʕa)
# اِخْضَوْضِعَا (iḵḍawḍiʕā) /ix.dˤaw.dˤi.ʕaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِخْضَوْضَعَ (iḵḍawḍaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
